name: 22437-ngramspec-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), sm90.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=128, bounded at 1280 requests with a 3600 s safety cap, warmup the first 15% by request count. Seed static 42.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets. Prompt EXACTLY 1500 tokens and output EXACTLY 256, min = max, so every request is the same shape and the run is a fixed amount of work. `ignore_eos` is set, so all 256 tokens are always generated; the request is sent as plain text with no chat template, so add_special_tokens puts the ENGINE's prompt count at roughly 1501 rather than 1500, which is not drift.
purpose: A long-document summarizer for an 8B assistant, serving 128 concurrent users with uniform 1500-token prompts on one GPU.
launch:
# Single-GPU serve of an 8B chat model with n-gram speculative decoding switched on.

# meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct is gated to this host; this is the ungated mirror.
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct

# Inline JSON on ONE line: this declaration is read line by line and indented lines are skipped,
# so re-flowing it into a block mapping drops the key and the engine starts with no drafter at rc=0.
speculative-config: {"method": "ngram", "num_speculative_tokens": 7, "prompt_lookup_min": 3, "prompt_lookup_max": 20}

tensor-parallel-size: 1

dtype: bfloat16

max-model-len: 4096
